title: Search and Rescue First Aid Guidance
disclaimer: First aid guidance for bystanders and rescue operators. This guidance is for immediate support only, never a medical diagnosis. All medical decisions require qualified professional care.

steps.title: Check Breathing
steps.guidance: Check for normal breathing: gently tilt the head back and look, listen, and feel for chest movement and breath for up to 10 seconds.

steps.title: Control Severe Bleeding
steps.guidance: Apply firm, direct pressure on the bleeding wound with a clean cloth or dressing. If an object is embedded, press around it without removing it.

steps.title: Do Not Move Neck or Spine
steps.guidance: Do not move the neck or back unless the casualty is in immediate danger. Support the head with your hands to keep the head, neck, and spine aligned.

steps.title: Place in Recovery Position
steps.guidance: If the casualty is unresponsive but breathing normally and not in danger of spinal trauma, roll them onto their side to keep the airway open.

steps.title: Keep Warm and Prevent Shock
steps.guidance: Cover the casualty with a blanket, jacket, or dry cloth to preserve body warmth and prevent shock. Do not apply direct artificial heat.

steps.title: Reassure and Monitor
steps.guidance: Stay with the casualty, speak calmly to reassure them, and monitor breathing continuously until emergency medical personnel arrive.
